reviews.text: Dear Oliver, Thanks for your review. We appreciate a lot.
The staff is very friendly, they do an excellent job, and the prices are very reasonable. My dog ​​always looks fantastic. Thank you!
Dear Ester, Thank you for your review
Fast & helpful. Accept walk-ins.
The best place for dogs! I highly recommend them. Thank you, Carlos, for being so kind and taking such good care of our dogs. You guys are the best!
I been coming to this grooming place and I had try so many and this one to me is the best they don’t do it as rush as factory really takes the time with your animal will recommended 100%
Dear Susana, Thank you for your review. We appreciate a lot.
I absolutely love this place, and my dog ​​loves it too. They leave him perfectly groomed and clean. The best place to leave my four-legged friend!
Professional service, very flexible, dog trusts them and always comes home happy. Recommend to everyone who has a pet nearby.

Princess and Dukes has been amazing with my dog, Bella.
She has always been treated so well every time we visit, and it really shows how much they care about the animals.
The staff is kind, attentive, and genuinely loves what they do.
I always feel comfortable leaving Bella in their hands.
Highly recommend!

I've been bringing my dog ​​Axel here for almost a year now, and I couldn't be happier with the service. They always treat him with so much love, patience, and professionalism. Axel leaves spotless, happy, and well cared for every time.

You can tell they truly love animals and take the time to do a quality job. For me, that's the most important thing. Plus, the place is always clean and organized.

I definitely recommend them 100%. Thank you for taking such good care of my baby! 🐶✨

My dog ​​has been going to this salon since she was 5 months old and I would never change it. They provide excellent service and I'm very satisfied with their work. My dog ​​is now 7 years old and I highly recommend them! 🥰🥰🥰
Dear Nathaly, thank you so much for your review, we really appreciate it.

This establishment is an absolute gem for pet owners. They are incredibly caring, efficient, and genuinely passionate about the well-being of their furry friends. They go above and beyond to provide exceptional pet care. Highly recommended!
I have been taking my 3 fur babies here for years. I love the treatment and care they provide. Amazing staff and fast!

Amazing staff, they are truly animal lovers. My Husky is always happy to see the groomer. For a dog who dislikes car rides, always excited to get picked up. My frenchie which is a very delicate dog is well taken care of. Highly recommend.

This is the best pet salon .They treat my dog with so much care always make sure that she is left beautiful.Always make sure that she is okay they remember names and always treat her like she is family great price the best recommended 100%

I have been coming here for quite some time. I am very happy with the service provided. My dog is not afraid of the groomers and is eager to get his haircut which is an extremely good sign and the dogs are treated with love and care. I have recommended these groomers to other family members and friends and all have had the same good experience. I would recommend these groomers to anyone. Prices are also very fair and The team will try to accommodate you and are very punctual.
I love Princess and Duke pet groomers!! Great people, great service and all 3 of my puppies have always been so happy! I’ve been using their services for 10+ years.
The service is excellent, they are always very friendly and the pets leave looking beautiful and happy.
Good afternoon.I have been taking my dog  to this place for four years , and I am very satisfied with the care and service .I recommend it 100% .thank you so much.
Terrible service, nothing like the photos, they don't even know how to groom dogs
Thank you so much for your review. We really appreciate it and are happy to meet your expectations.

This was my first time taking my furry friends Ranger and Luna to Princess and Dukes Pet Salon, and I loved the service and their haircuts. I'm very happy with the service, and Mr. Carlos was very kind. I'm very grateful to the lady who cut their hair, and I was pleased with the cuts. I loved that they gave Ranger a little Christmas bow tie and Luna a little bow, just as I asked. They were very friendly, and the price was reasonable. Thank you for everything, and yes, I will definitely take them back to Princess and Dukes Pet Salon. :-)
Always spectacular! Dedication and love towards your pets as if they were their own! ❤️

Do not go here! Took my dog here and got her back dusty and with dandruff. They cut her whiskers and she was handed back to me trembling. When confronted, they denied it, saying her whiskers were that size before.
My pooch gets happy when we arrive, and darts out of my truck to go inside.  They are fast and economical in pricing, and my girl comes out looking like a Princess.
Excellent experience, very good service, 100% recommended, they took great care of the dog 🤗 …
They treat the furry ones of the house well and they leave happy and relaxed like my girl.
Excellent service; friendly attention and best of all, the care and dedication to caring for and achieving what was requested for our little ones 🐶🐺’ …

Don't bring your pet to this place!

From the owner to the person who bathes the dogs, everyone is rude and the service is terrible. You'd have to wonder what kind of care the dogs get after you leave. Plus, they try to overcharge you for everything!

Awful service
Great groomers! I've been coming here for years. My dogs love them. They're never scared and always come back looking cute! Professional and friendly staff. Clean location.
Today was my first visit to this salon and I was very satisfied, thank you for your attention, 🙏🙏 my dog ​​looks beautiful 🥰🥰🥰 …
The staff is friendly, professional and truly cares  about pets confort. I highly recommend Dukes pet salon to anyone looking for quality pet grooming
Loved the service and my dog came out happy and clean. The prices are really good. We’ll be coming back for sure!
It's one of the best grooming I've ever met. The treatment of my pet and how beautiful they leave it every time I take it has no comparison
This salon offers excellent services. I'm very satisfied with the service, the attention, and the care they showed my pet. Thank you, Yailen and Carlos, for everything! 🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰 …

I love the service & attention that they have with my dog every time that I take her. My groomer- Yailen, is the best in Hialeah. I really do recommend this establishment for all your dog grooming needs. 5 STARS ⭐️ for sure!
Excellent attention and good service, I highly recommend them….

🚫Terrible service!

They treat you rudely, they don't respect their customers… as if they were doing you a favor!

Don't go to this place!

Every time, from the first time I came to this place, the owner ALWAYS has a sour face and a bad attitude…

as if he's bothered by what he does, bothered by serving customers, rude, and impolite.

You call to make an appointment and he hangs up on you!

He's incredibly rude!!!!!

Initially, aside from his attitude, I was satisfied with the service they give my dogs, which isn't the best either… which is understandable!

They keep trying to charge double for "knots."

Their hours say they close at 6 pm. But it's also true that other times they've called me at that same time ("closing time") to let me know the dogs are ready… Of course! They set their hours for their own convenience.

Sorry; I arrived 10 minutes after 6 pm this time; but I've had enough of their mistreatment of me as a customer!

PATHETIC!

I left very happy because my Golden Retriever is very nervous and suffers from panic attacks when he's scared of something unfamiliar, and it was the first time I'd taken him to a groomer for a bath and haircut. Apparently, the service was excellent because Apolo came out smelling great, clean, and completely stress-free (I was the one who was stressed waiting for news).
Thank you for being patient with Apolo and doing such a good job with him. I know I can bring him back because you gave me confidence. Thank you.
I've been taking our dogs there for several years and the service is very good. We're going there today! 😀 …

I took my dog ​​there for the second time and I still don't like it. The first time, the person who attended to me was very unfriendly, but I did see good work. The second and last time, the man who attended to me was very unpleasant. He didn't even thank me for the service, and on top of that, they only bathed her and trimmed her face when I paid for a full service. I went on a recommendation and returned later because I felt they deserved another chance, but I regretted it. Nobody wants to pay for an incomplete service. Horrible.
The best, highly recommended
I'm absolutely delighted with the service; every time I go, they treat Milan like a plush toy.

Excellent service and attention, my dogs love coming here. Their prices are great, I travel 25 minutes just to come here. And best of all, they treat the dogs very well and always leave them looking beautiful.
I bring my doodle here every four weeks and I always leave happy and so does he. 🐾😍 …
The young woman is very kind and professional. I took my daughter there for the first time and was very impressed. I will definitely continue to use them.
I was very pleased with the staff's service and how they treated my pet. They are very professional, and I congratulate them on what they do and how they do it 👍🏻❤️🐶 …
The service was excellent and my dog ​​looked beautiful.

This place was amazing, they work very professionally and they truly care about your pet. It’s the first grooming salon that I found for my Luna that I truly love. Wonderful work and very kind and loving with your pet, excellent care and service from the owner and the girl that works there. I definitely recommend this place

Staff is rude, they don’t even bother on greeting customers!! This is the 2nd and last time I bring my dog to that place. Its been less than a week and my dog is already stinking. Im not sure what kind of bath was done. $100 dollars wasted
Thank you so much for your services! I sent my cocker spaniel to that wonderful place, and Eusebio did the grooming. It turned out spectacular! Congratulations to you both, and I recommend you 100%.

I'm very happy with the service my pet received at this center for the first time. She came out looking beautiful and smelling amazing. I'm very impressed with their attention to detail and very reasonable prices. I highly recommend them.

This place is TERRIBLE the worker is rude, one of the workers one day shaved my dog TO THE BONE because she didn't know what to do. After so many years with them they don't have any type of consideration with anyone. Recently I took my Pomeranian to bathe and they shaved her private area to the point she is in PAIN and had to give her triple antibiotic. they charged me $71 for A CUT. Disappointing and disgusting place. Do not go here whatsoever. This place is truly disturbing and RUDE! Learn how to have some etiquette and do your job correctly instead. this  place deserves to be TAKEN DOWN.
Had to take her to the vet and turns out her private area is completely has rashes from a machine. She’s in so much pain. Super unprofessional
